semantic_inputs: public PLOS Computational Biology article DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719
actions: Verified frozen control/config tuple using SHA-only Git-ref lookup before semantic work.

Audited the newly published PLOS SPLiT article and confirmed S1 Code DOI, Oja re-orthonormalization cadence, feedback coupling, frozen/adaptive rotational-drift controls, and the paper's own low-rank projection/pseudoinverse caveat.
Attempted file-level S1 Code recovery; the current public text/browser transport exposed the Code.zip declaration but not the binary archive.
Derived and numerically validated fixed-manifold equivalence between ambient normalized LMS and intrinsic normalized LMS.
Ran disjoint-tuned, 20-seed rotating low-rank matched controls comparing oracle, Oja, aligned EW-PCA, frozen coordinates, ambient normalized LMS and tuned full-space RLS.
Ran a separate 20-seed closed-loop teacher-feedback analogue to test sensitivity of Oja/PCA/full-space controls to feedback-coupled recurrent state changes.
result: Adaptive subspace tracking is supported, but Oja-specific computational superiority is not isolated. Fixed-manifold normalized LMS is algebraically equivalent in ambient and intrinsic coordinates; generic aligned EW-PCA matched Oja/oracle at the reduced rotating-subspace endpoint; tuned full-space RLS and ambient normalized LMS were competitive. The source-exact Code.zip remains the decisive missing artifact for a stronger conclusion.
blocker: PLOS S1 Code binary archive DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719.s002 could not be downloaded through the currently available public text transport; this is a transport limitation, not evidence that code is absent.
exact_next_action: Recover S1 Code through a file-capable public path and reproduce S11/S12 or constrained 2-Hz sine exactly. Add full-space normalized LMS, generic aligned subspace tracker + NLMS with matched latent budget, tuned full-space RLS/ridge/pseudoinverse, and frozen manifold controls under identical seeds and exact feedback.
